title: Align Source startup grace with measured dev cold start
summary: Align Source Ingestion healthcheck start_period from 5s to 120s in docker-compose.yml to match measured dev cold start of 109s, preserving all readiness predicates and unhealthy rejection behavior.
problem_statement: During formal dev Root deployment cutover, measured Source Ingestion cold start took 109 seconds, exceeding the 5-second healthcheck start_period in docker-compose.yml.

changes.change: Updated services.source-ingest.healthcheck.start_period from 5s to 120s while keeping test probe (/readyz), 10s interval, 5s timeout, and 10 retries unchanged.

criterion_1.statement: Source startup grace 120s with original readiness predicates preserved
criterion_1.details: services.source-ingest.healthcheck.start_period set to 120s. Probe test command ('import os, urllib.request; port=os.environ.get(\'PORT\',\'8097\'); urllib.request.urlopen(f\'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/readyz\', timeout=5).read()'), interval (10s), timeout (5s), and retries (10) remain identical.

criterion_2.statement: Real Compose rendering and existing health tests pass
criterion_2.details: docker compose config --quiet and docker compose config source-ingest render start_period: 2m0s (120s) without warnings. services/source_ingestion/test_compose_activation.py (2 passed), services/source_ingestion/tests/test_source_readiness_bounded.py (1 passed), services/source_ingestion/tests/test_usage_health.py (31 passed), and services/source_ingestion/test_service.py (31 passed) pass.

criterion_3.statement: Exact product review and required CI merge evidence
criterion_3.details: Evidence committed to exact PR head; PR will be submitted with auto-merge off and handed off to reviewer Claude for exact-head approval and supervisor integration merge.

criterion_4.statement: No live mutation or duplicate Root dispatch
criterion_4.details: No live VM or container mutations performed; all changes scoped cleanly to task worktree and branch.
